category_title: Students who are hesitant or fearful of physical challenges
minimal_context: The student is standing on the high platform preparing to jump off for the zip line.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, it is your turn to jump off the platform for the zip line.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not gonna do that. I am sort of afraid of heights.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just step closer to the edge and get ready.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am really scared of falling. I don't know if I can do this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: The equipment is set up. You just need to jump.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands frozen on the platform) I know I need to trust the belayers and trust the equipment, but I'm too scared of falling to take the extra step right now.
